plan:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'contract_version','finance-monthly-plan.v1','cycle_id',cy.id,'allocation_run_id',ar.id,
 'cycle_version',cy.version,'run_status',ar.status,'input_hash',ar.input_hash,
 'mappings',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('batch_id',batch.id,'rule_id',rule.id,'input_id',i.id,
   'source_type',i.source_type,'source_id',i.source_id,'capture_id',s.id,'source_hash',s.source_hash,
   'debtors',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('unit_id',d->>'unit_id','party_id',d->>'party_id') order by d->>'unit_id')
     from jsonb_array_elements(rule.parameters->'unit_bases') d)) order by batch.id)
   from finance.statutory_allocation_batches batch join finance.allocation_inputs i on i.id=batch.allocation_input_id
   join finance.monthly_cycle_sources s on s.cycle_id=cy.id and s.tenant_id=cy.tenant_id and s.source_type=i.source_type and s.source_id=i.source_id
   join finance.allocation_rules rule on rule.id=(select b.provenance->>'allocation_rule_id' from finance.statutory_allocation_bases b where b.batch_id=batch.id order by b.unit_id limit 1)::uuid
   where batch.allocation_run_id=ar.id and batch.tenant_id=cy.tenant_id)) plan
 from finance.monthly_cycles cy join finance.allocation_runs ar on ar.id=cy.allocation_run_id and ar.tenant_id=cy.tenant_id
 join platform.customer_workspaces w on w.tenant_id=cy.tenant_id and w.id=$3
 where cy.id=$1 and cy.tenant_id=$2 and ar.id=$4
 and auth.uid()=$5::uuid and txid_current()::text=$7
 and app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2($6::uuid,$3::uuid,'finance.allocations.read','accounting') is true
 and app_private.can_access_property(cy.property_id) is true
readback:
select k.actor_id,k.request_hash,k.response_ref,k.expires_at>clock_timestamp() unexpired
    from platform.idempotency_keys k where k.tenant_id=$1 and k.key=$2
    and auth.uid()=$3::uuid and txid_current()::text=$4
    and app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2($5::uuid,$6::uuid,$7,$8) is true
validation:
select cy.id from finance.monthly_cycles cy
        join finance.accounting_periods ap on ap.id=cy.accounting_period_id
        join platform.customer_workspaces w on w.tenant_id=cy.tenant_id
        where cy.id=$1 and cy.tenant_id=$2 and w.id=$3 and w.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE'
        and ap.status='open' and cy.status='collecting' and cy.version=$4
